notes:
### In-app auto-updater
- Sidebar Update badge + Data Management → Software Update: check, download (SHA-256 verified), install & restart — a full safety snapshot is taken before every install
- Releases publish to the public JITM-Updates feed; future updates arrive in-app

### Shell & navigation
- Back / Forward / Reload buttons in the tab row (per-tab stack; never touches browser history)
- Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycle tabs from anywhere, including inside frames
- POS tab collapses the sidebar behind an inline hamburger button
- Tab bar scrollbar hidden while wheel/horizontal scrolling is kept

### Fixes
- Browser Back while signed in can never show the login page; frame Back/forward bounce out of /login
- In-frame re-login lands on Home instead of nesting the shell
- Sidebar sub-menus no longer clip at 6+ items
- 0-byte xlsx export fixed
